SQL_DOC.V_SQL: SELECT TARGET AS BUYER, TO_CHAR(KEY_1) AS INV_NO, TO_CHAR(KEY_2) AS INV_SEQ FROM ICOMTRXL C WHERE DOC_NAME = 'BPO_IVDOWN' AND TRIM(KEY_9) IS NULL AND EXISTS ( SELECT 'X' FROM ICOMCOD2 A WHERE A.COMPANY_CODE = C.TARGET AND A.TYPE = 'BPO1' ) AND EXISTS ( SELECT 'X' FROM ICOMIVDT A, ICOMPODT B WHERE A.BUYER = C.TARGET AND A.INV_NO = C.KEY_1 AND A.INV_SEQ = C.KEY_2 AND A.BUYER = B.BUYER AND A.PO_NO = B.PO_NO AND A.PO_SEQ = B.PO_SEQ AND B.PROCESS_TYPE = '0' ) UNION ALL SELECT TARGET AS BUYER, TO_CHAR(KEY_1) AS INV_NO, TO_CHAR(KEY_2) AS INV_SEQ FROM ICOMTRXL C WHERE DOC_NAME = 'BPO_IVDOWN' AND TRIM(KEY_9) IS NULL AND EXISTS ( SELECT 'X' FROM ICOMCOD2 A WHERE A.COMPANY_CODE = C.TARGET AND A.TYPE = 'BPO1' ) AND EXISTS ( SELECT 'X' FROM WMSIVDT E, ICOMPODT B WHERE E.BUYER = C.TARGET AND E.INV_NO = C.KEY_1 AND E.INV_SEQ = C.KEY_2 AND E.BUYER = B.BUYER AND E.PO_NO = B.PO_NO AND E.PO_SEQ = B.PO_SEQ AND B.PROCESS_TYPE != '0' )
